description: EyesofArgus is a team of builders, explorers, and problem-solvers driven by curiosity about our world and beyond. We combine software engineering, AI, data, science, and creativity to turn complex information into meaningful experiences. Inspired by Argus and his many eyes, we believe better observation leads to better understanding—and technology can help us see what others cannot.
summary: EarthEyes is an interactive platform that makes NASA-ISRO NISAR radar data understandable for students, researchers, and communities. Users select an area and compare observations from different dates to investigate signs of ice change, coastal shifts, flooding, and other environmental changes. Visual comparisons, plain-language summaries, and Argus, our AI guide, help users explore what looks different and what it might mean. With links to source observations and clearly stated limitations, EarthEyes helps people understand changes in the places they care about while distinguishing evidence from possible explanations.
details:
From shifting coastlines to changing glaciers, Earth's changes affect the places we call home. Understanding the satellite evidence behind them should not be limited to specialists.

Built by Team EyesofArgus, five students from Daffodil International University, EarthEyes makes radar data from the NASA-ISRO NISAR mission easier to explore and understand. Users select an area, compare observations from different dates, and investigate signs of ice change, coastal shifts, flooding, and more. Interactive maps, visual comparisons, plain-language summaries, and Argus, our AI guide, help users explore what looks different and what it might mean. Links to source observations and clear limitations keep possible explanations distinct from confirmed findings.

Our goal is to put understandable satellite evidence within reach of students, researchers, and communities, connecting a global view of our changing planet to the places people care about.

EarthEyes. See the change. Understand the evidence.
